title: Codex preview
subtitle: An independent Codex conversation. Existing chat stays unchanged.
limits: Preview supports local projects and text only. Native tools, attachments, model switching and usage accounting are not available. Leaving does not stop an active task, but cancels pending approvals.
errorHelp: This operation was not confirmed. Your input is retained. Check the state first. When the outcome is uncertain, close and resume the original session to reconcile its history before sending again.
profileWarning: Choose a trusted Codex executable and a separate data directory. Reusing Vetta models requires no second gateway credential setup. MCP servers or plugins configured in that directory can still have remote effects outside the local read-only sandbox.
confirmMessage: Saving does not launch the program. Creating or resuming a session will. Verify the executable, authentication directory and permissions.
approvalScope: The full request is shown below. Approval applies only to this operation. Stopping, leaving this page or request expiry invalidates it.
empty: No conversation yet. Configure Codex, then create or resume a session.
earlier: This bounded view shows at most 200 records. Full history remains with Codex.
truncated: This displayed record is truncated. Full content remains in Codex history.
draftHelp: You may draft the next instruction while a task runs. An unchanged draft clears only after successful completion; failure or stop preserves it.
versionHelp: The exact version must match codex --version. A match is not compatibility certification. Preview does not install Codex or sign in automatically.

permissions.workspace-write: Workspace writes; ask for additional permissions

phases.recovery: Reconciliation required; close and resume the original session

existingModel: Use an existing Vetta gateway and model
codexHomeModel: Use the model configured in Codex home
modelLoadFailed: Could not read model settings. Your input is retained. Refresh to retry.
modelMissing: The previously selected model is missing or unavailable. Select it again.
reuseHelp: Reuse the URL, credential, headers and proxy from Vetta model settings. No separate ChatGPT login or copied API key is required.
responsesOnly: This preview requires models explicitly configured for OpenAI Responses. Other protocols are not converted automatically.
dataHomeHelp: Codex home stores separate runtime history. When using a Vetta gateway, no API key needs to be configured in this directory.
modelEmpty: No models are listed yet. Configure your gateway and a Responses model in Vetta model settings, then refresh this list.
